topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences I, Exercise – medium
title: First Conditional: Real Future Situations

explanation.tr:
Birinci tip koşul cümlesi (First Conditional), gelecekte gerçekten olabilecek durumlar için kullanılır.
• Yapı: If + present simple, will + fiil
• If it rains, we will stay at home.
• If-cümlesinde 'will' kullanılmaz: If you come (✓), If you will come (✗).
• Cümleler yer değiştirebilir: We will stay at home if it rains. If başta ise virgül koyulur.
• Olumsuz: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
• 'will' yerine can, may, must veya emir cümlesi de gelebilir: If you are tired, go to bed.
explanation.tk:
Birinji görnüşli şert sözlemi (First Conditional) geljekde hakykatdan bolup biljek ýagdaýlar üçin ulanylýar.
• Gurluşy: If + present simple, will + işlik
• If it rains, we will stay at home.
• If böleginde 'will' ulanylmaýar: If you come (✓), If you will come (✗).
• Bölekleriň ýerini çalşyp bolýar: We will stay at home if it rains. If başda bolsa, otur goýulýar.
• Ýokluk görnüşi: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
• 'will' ýerine can, may, must ýa-da buýruk hem gelip biler: If you are tired, go to bed.
explanation.ru:
Условные предложения первого типа (First Conditional) описывают реальные ситуации в будущем.
• Схема: If + present simple, will + глагол
• If it rains, we will stay at home.
• В части с if 'will' не используется: If you come (✓), If you will come (✗).
• Части можно поменять местами: We will stay at home if it rains. Если if стоит в начале, ставится запятая.
• Отрицание: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
• Вместо 'will' возможны can, may, must или повелительное наклонение: If you are tired, go to bed.

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences – type II – statements
title: Second Conditional: Imaginary Situations

explanation.tr:
İkinci tip koşul cümlesi (Second Conditional) şu an gerçek olmayan veya olma ihtimali düşük, hayali durumlar için kullanılır.
• Yapı: If + past simple, would + fiil
• If I had a car, I would drive to work. (Arabam yok.)
• 'be' fiili tüm öznelerle genellikle 'were' olur: If I were rich, I would travel.
• Tavsiye için: If I were you, I would ...
• 'would' yerine 'could' veya 'might' de kullanılabilir: If she had time, she could help us.
• Kısaltma: I would = I'd, you would = you'd.
explanation.tk:
Ikinji görnüşli şert sözlemi (Second Conditional) häzirki wagtda hakyky bolmadyk ýa-da bolmagy az ähtimal bolan, hyýaly ýagdaýlar üçin ulanylýar.
• Gurluşy: If + past simple, would + işlik
• If I had a car, I would drive to work. (Maşynym ýok.)
• 'be' işligi ähli eýeler bilen köplenç 'were' bolýar: If I were rich, I would travel.
• Maslahat üçin: If I were you, I would ...
• 'would' ýerine 'could' ýa-da 'might' hem ulanyp bolýar: If she had time, she could help us.
• Gysgaltma: I would = I'd, you would = you'd.
explanation.ru:
Условные предложения второго типа (Second Conditional) описывают нереальные или маловероятные ситуации в настоящем.
• Схема: If + past simple, would + глагол
• If I had a car, I would drive to work. (Машины нет.)
• Глагол 'be' обычно 'were' для всех лиц: If I were rich, I would travel.
• Совет: If I were you, I would ...
• Вместо 'would' можно 'could' или 'might': If she had time, she could help us.
• Сокращения: I would = I'd, you would = you'd.

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences – type II – negations
title: Second Conditional: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
İkinci tip koşul cümlesinde olumsuzluk iki yerde olabilir.
• If kısmında: If + didn't + fiil / weren't
  If I didn't have homework, I would watch a film.
  If it weren't so cold, we would go out.
• Ana cümlede: wouldn't (would not) + fiil
  If I were tired, I wouldn't go to the party.
• İkisi birden: If he didn't eat so much, he wouldn't feel ill.
• Dikkat: 'didn't' sonrası fiil yalın hâldedir: didn't have (✓), didn't had (✗).
explanation.tk:
Ikinji görnüşli şert sözleminde ýokluk iki ýerde bolup biler.
• If böleginde: If + didn't + işlik / weren't
  If I didn't have homework, I would watch a film.
  If it weren't so cold, we would go out.
• Esasy bölekde: wouldn't (would not) + işlik
  If I were tired, I wouldn't go to the party.
• Ikisinde hem: If he didn't eat so much, he wouldn't feel ill.
• Üns beriň: 'didn't'-den soň işlik esasy görnüşde bolýar: didn't have (✓), didn't had (✗).
explanation.ru:
Во втором типе условных предложений отрицание может быть в двух местах.
• В части с if: If + didn't + глагол / weren't
  If I didn't have homework, I would watch a film.
  If it weren't so cold, we would go out.
• В главной части: wouldn't (would not) + глагол
  If I were tired, I wouldn't go to the party.
• В обеих: If he didn't eat so much, he wouldn't feel ill.
• Внимание: после 'didn't' глагол в начальной форме: didn't have (✓), didn't had (✗).

topic: Conditional sentences (if-clauses and main clauses): Conditional sentences II – mixed
title: Second Conditional: Mixed Practice

explanation.tr:
Bu alıştırmada ikinci tip koşul cümlesinin olumlu, olumsuz ve soru biçimlerini karışık çalışacaksın.
• Olumlu: If I had time, I would help you.
• Olumsuz: If I didn't have time, I wouldn't help you.
• Soru: What would you do if you won the lottery?
• Soruda would özneden önce gelir: Would you go if they invited you?
• Kısa cevap: Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.
• Hatırla: if kısmında past simple, diğer kısımda would/could/might + fiil.
explanation.tk:
Bu gönükmede ikinji görnüşli şert sözleminiň tassyklaýjy, ýokluk we sorag görnüşlerini garyşyk türgenleşersiň.
• Tassyklaýjy: If I had time, I would help you.
• Ýokluk: If I didn't have time, I wouldn't help you.
• Sorag: What would you do if you won the lottery?
• Soragda would eýeden öň gelýär: Would you go if they invited you?
• Gysga jogap: Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.
• Ýatda sakla: if böleginde past simple, beýleki bölekde would/could/might + işlik.
explanation.ru:
В этом упражнении ты потренируешь утвердительные, отрицательные и вопросительные формы второго типа.
• Утверждение: If I had time, I would help you.
• Отрицание: If I didn't have time, I wouldn't help you.
• Вопрос: What would you do if you won the lottery?
• В вопросе would стоит перед подлежащим: Would you go if they invited you?
• Краткий ответ: Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.
• Помни: в части с if — past simple, в другой — would/could/might + глагол.
